subject.title: [Bug]: Agent self-update bypasses update.run and uses raw npm global upgrade without restarting gateway

question: Should maintainers rework and land the linked candidate fix into the shared exec-control guard, replace it with a maintainer-owned patch, or explicitly allow raw exec package-manager self-updates with documented restart responsibility?
rationale: The issue is protected and the remaining choice involves the permanent command-execution boundary for self-updates, including whether existing exec-based operator workflows should be hard-blocked.

options.title: Rework and land the shared guard
options.body: Move the raw OpenClaw package-manager detector into `src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.ts`, cover exec and exec-review consumers, and use the linked pull request or a replacement patch as the landing path.

options.title: Replace with a maintainer patch
options.body: Close or supersede the linked pull request only after a narrower maintainer-owned patch provides the same prelaunch guard and proof.

options.title: Allow raw exec updates
options.body: Keep the raw package-manager path available only if maintainers intentionally accept the restart burden and document the supported recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Rework and land the shared guard
recommendation.body: Move the raw OpenClaw package-manager detector into `src/infra/exec-control-command-guard.ts`, cover exec and exec-review consumers, and use the linked pull request or a replacement patch as the landing path.

likelyOwner.reason: The most central remaining code boundary is the shared exec-control guard that vincentkoc recently helped establish.
